patthana13.1:1.1: sammāsambuddhassa → sammāsambuddhassa anulomapaccanīya tikapaṭṭhānaṁ kusalattike nakusalattikaṁ (sya-all)
patthana13.1:2.1: kusale → kusalo (bj) | naakusalo → na kusalo (bj) | naakusalo ca dhammā → na akusalo dhammo (bj) | rūpaṁ → rūpaṁ pañca (bj, sya-all)
patthana13.1:7.1: paṭicca naakusalo → na akusalo (bj) | ārammaṇapaccayā → ārammaṇapaccayā tīṇi (bj, sya-all)
patthana13.1:11.1: nakusalo → na abyākato (bj) | nahetupaccayā → hetupaccayā (bj); nahetupaccayā tīṇi (sya-all) | naabyākato → na akusalo (bj)
patthana13.1:18.1: naabyākatassa → na akusalassa (bj, sya-all) | akusalo → pañca abyākato (bj, sya-all) | nakusalassa ca naakusalassa ca → na kusalassa (bj, sya-all)
patthana13.1:19.1: nakusalassa → na akusalassa (bj, sya-all) | paccayo → paccayo tīṇi (bj, sya-all)
